title.subtitle: Install runtimes and node packs in one place.

empty.noMatchDesc: Try a different search term or switch the status filter back to All.

console.empty: No output yet. Logs appear here during install.

footer.restartNotice: Changes take effect after the NodeTool server restarts.

packs.stateUnknownMode: Inactive. The installed manifest is not a supported BrainVite-AI-Canvas pack, so trust cannot be granted.{{reason}}
packs.stateSandboxOnly: Active. Its modules run inside the sandbox with the importing node's capabilities. No host code and no lifecycle scripts ran.
packs.stateTrusted: Trusted. Lifecycle scripts ran against the artifact that was installed.
packs.stateInactive: Inactive. It installed with lifecycle scripts disabled and runs no host code until you approve trust.
packs.stateUnknownLedger: Installed outside the current install ledger, so its mode is unknown here.
packs.installDescription1: Paste an npm package name, e.g. @acme/cool-nodes or cool-nodes@1.2.3. The server must be restarted to load the new pack.
packs.installDescription2: Installing runs no pack code. A pack that ships sandbox modules is active right away, and those modules run inside your workflows with the node's capabilities once a node imports one. A pack that registers host nodes stays inactive until you approve trust.
packs.installUnavailable: Node pack install is not available in this build.
packs.allowUnlistedTitle: Load packs that are not on the allowlist
packs.allowUnlistedHint: Off in production by default. When off, only packs you've explicitly trusted will load.
packs.emptyElectron: No node packs discovered. Install one with npm install or via the field above.
packs.emptyPlain: No node packs discovered. Install one with npm install.
